Data Collected and Purposes

Calculator: when you use the calculator, we collect the information you enter about your fish consumption, as well as your email address if you provide it. This data is used to calculate your results. It is also used to produce anonymous statistics on fish consumption for our work and publications. Legal basis: your consent, given when you use the calculator.

Newsletter: if you subscribe to the newsletter, we collect your email address to send you information about our campaigns and our work. Legal basis: your consent. You can unsubscribe at any time using the link included in each email.
Recipients
Your data is intended solely for Seastemik. It is neither sold nor transferred to third parties. It is hosted and processed by our technical service providers, acting on our behalf:
Some of these service providers are located in the United States. Data transfers are governed by the safeguards provided for under the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR).
As with any website, the hosting provider also records technical connection data, including IP addresses, to ensure the operation and security of the Website.
Cookies
The Website does not set any advertising or tracking cookies.
Your Rights

Under the GDPR and the amended French Data Protection Act of 6 January 1978, you have the following rights regarding your data: access, rectification, erasure, objection, restriction and portability. You may withdraw your consent at any time. To exercise these rights, write to <email>info@seastemik.org</email>. You may also lodge a complaint with the CNIL (<cnil>www.cnil.fr</cnil>).
